name: mtodo
description: mTodo - a modern TODO PoC (Express + SQLite + React + TypeScript)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.db:backup: docker compose -p mtodo -f docker/docker-compose.yml exec backup sh /scripts/backup.sh
scripts.db:backups: docker compose -p mtodo -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm backup sh /scripts/restore.sh --list
scripts.db:restore: docker compose -p mtodo -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm backup sh /scripts/restore.sh
